主要内容: Emily M. Nikoo, an Executive Vice President of Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc., notified the company on January 7, 2016, of her resignation effective April 1, 2016. On January 13, 2016, the company and Ms. Nikoo entered into a letter agreement outlining her separation terms. Under the agreement, her employment and officer status will end on April 1, 2016, with continued base salary and benefits until that date. She will receive $2,000 per week for up to 16 weeks following her last day, contingent on not starting new full-time employment or receiving income exceeding $2,000 weekly from consulting. The company also agreed to transfer her company-provided vehicle and revise the vesting period for 25,000 restricted shares, originally set to vest in three installments on May 19, 2016, 2017, and 2018. The summary is qualified by reference to the full letter agreement, filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Form 8-K.
